results.push(doctor_check_heartbeat_dir(&heartbeat_dir, repair));\n\n    // Heartbeat file staleness\n    results.push(doctor_check_heartbeats(\n        &heartbeat_dir,\n        config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs,\n        repair,\n    ));\n\n    // Peer status\n    results.push(doctor_check_peers(\n        &heartbeat_dir,\n        config.health.heartbeat_ttl_secs,\n    ));\n\n    // Agent binary availability\n    results.push(doctor_check_agent_binary(&config));\n\n    // Adapter transform binaries\n    results.push(doctor_check_adapter_transforms(&config));\n\n    // Disk space\n    results.push(doctor_check_disk_space(&workspace_root));\n\n    // Telemetry logs\n    results.push(doctor_check_telemetry_logs(&config, &needle_home, repair));\n\n    // Print results.\n    for r in &results {\n        println!(\"{}\", r.display());\n        for line in &r.detail {\n            println!(\"         └─ {line}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Summary.\n    let fails = results\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Fail)\n        .count();\n    let warns = results\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Warn)\n        .count();\n    let passed = results\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|r| r.status == CheckStatus::Pass)\n        .count();\n\n    println!(\"{}\", \"─\".repeat(width));\n    if fails == 0 && warns == 0 {\n        println!(\"{passed} check(s) passed.\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"{passed} passed, {warns} warning(s), {fails} failure(s).\");\n        if !repair && (fails > 0 || warns > 0) {\n            println!(\"Run `needle doctor --repair` to attempt automatic fixes.\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Logs command\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle logs` — view and query telemetry logs.\nfn cmd_logs(\n    follow: bool,\n    filter: Vec<String>,\n    since: Option<String>,\n    until: Option<String>,\n    format: LogFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = ConfigLoader::load_global()?;\n    let needle_home = config.workspace.home.clone();\n    let log_dir = config\n        .telemetry\n        .file_sink\n        .log_dir\n        .clone()\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| needle_home.join(\"logs\"));\n\n    let filter_exprs: Vec<&str> = filter.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();\n    let logs_filter = if filter_exprs.is_empty() {\n        None\n    } else {\n        Some(telemetry::LogsFilter::parse(&filter_exprs)?)\n    };\n\n    let since_dt = since.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_since).transpose()?;\n    let until_dt = until.as_deref().map(telemetry::parse_until).transpose()?;\n\n    if follow {\n        cmd_logs_follow(&log_dir, logs_filter.as_ref(), since_dt, until_dt, &format)\n    } else {\n        cmd_logs_query(&log_dir, logs_filter.as_ref(), since_dt, until_dt, &format)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Non-follow mode: read all logs and print them.\nfn cmd_logs_query(\n    log_dir: &Path,\n    filter: Option<&telemetry::LogsFilter>,\n    since: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    format: &LogFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let events = telemetry::read_logs(log_dir, since, until, filter)?;\n\n    if events.is_empty() {\n        println!(\"No matching events found.\");\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    let stdout_sink = telemetry::StdoutSink::new(&StdoutSinkConfig {\n        enabled: true,\n        format: crate::config::StdoutFormat::Normal,\n        color: crate::config::ColorMode::Auto,\n    });\n\n    for event in &events {\n        match format {\n            LogFormat::Table | LogFormat::Human => {\n                println!(\"{}\", stdout_sink.format_event(event));\n            }\n            LogFormat::Json | LogFormat::Jsonl => {\n                let line = serde_json::to_string(event).context(\"failed to serialize event\")?;\n                println!(\"{line}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Follow mode: tail new events from all log files.\nfn cmd_logs_follow(\n    log_dir: &Path,\n    filter: Option<&telemetry::LogsFilter>,\n    since: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    until: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    format: &LogFormat,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    use std::io::BufRead;\n\n    if !log_dir.is_dir() {\n        bail!(\"log directory does not exist: {}\", log_dir.display());\n    }\n\n    let stdout_sink = telemetry::StdoutSink::new(&StdoutSinkConfig {\n        enabled: true,\n        format: crate::config::StdoutFormat::Normal,\n        color: crate::config::ColorMode::Auto,\n    });\n\n    // Build set of known log files and their current sizes (to tail from end).\n    let mut file_positions: std::collections::HashMap<PathBuf, u64> =\n        std::collections::HashMap::new();\n\n    // Print existing events since cutoff first, then tail.\n    if since.is_some() || filter.is_some() {\n        let events = telemetry::read_logs(log_dir, since, until, filter)?;\n        for event in &events {\n            print_log_event(event, format, &stdout_sink);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Record current positions (after initial read).\n    if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(log_dir) {\n        for entry in entries.flatten() {\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) == Some(\"jsonl\") {\n                let len = std::fs::metadata(&path).map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);\n                file_positions.insert(path, len);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Polling loop: check for new content every 500ms.\n    loop {\n        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));\n\n        // Check for new files.\n        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(log_dir) {\n            for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                let path = entry.path();\n                if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"jsonl\") {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                file_positions.entry(path).or_insert(0);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Read new content from each file.\n        let positions: Vec<(PathBuf, u64)> = file_positions\n            .iter()\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), *v))\n            .collect();\n        for (path, pos) in positions {\n            let current_len = std::fs::metadata(&path).map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);\n            if current_len <= pos {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let file = match std::fs::File::open(&path) {\n                Ok(f) => f,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            use std::io::Seek;\n            let mut reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);\n            if reader.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::Start(pos)).is_err() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let mut new_pos = pos;\n            let mut line_buf = String::new();\n            while reader.read_line(&mut line_buf).unwrap_or(0) > 0 {\n                let trimmed = line_buf.trim();\n                if !trimmed.is_empty() {\n                    if let Ok(event) = serde_json::from_str::<telemetry::TelemetryEvent>(trimmed) {\n                        let passes = filter.map(|f| f.matches(&event)).unwrap_or(true);\n                        let passes_until = until.map(|u| event.timestamp <= u).unwrap_or(true);\n                        if passes && passes_until {\n                            print_log_event(&event, format, &stdout_sink);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                new_pos += line_buf.len() as u64;\n                line_buf.clear();\n            }\n            file_positions.insert(path, new_pos);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Print a single telemetry event in the requested format.\nfn print_log_event(\n    event: &telemetry::TelemetryEvent,\n    format: &LogFormat,\n    sink: &telemetry::StdoutSink,\n) {\n    match format {\n        LogFormat::Table | LogFormat::Human => println!(\"{}\", sink.format_event(event)),\n        LogFormat::Json | LogFormat::Jsonl => {\n            if let Ok(line) = serde_json::to_string(event) {\n                println!(\"{line}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Status helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Per-worker status information for the status command.\nstruct WorkerStatus {\n    entry: WorkerEntry,\n    heartbeat_state: Option<String>,\n    current_bead: Option<String>,\n    pid_alive: bool,\n    uptime_secs: u64,\n}\n\n/// Check if a process with the given PID is alive.\nfn is_pid_alive(pid: u32) -> bool {\n    // kill(pid, 0) checks if process exists without sending a signal.\n    libc_kill(pid as i32, 0) == 0\n}\n\n/// Minimal binding to kill(2) — only used for PID existence check.\n///\n/// Returns 0 if the process exists, -1 otherwise.\nfn libc_kill(pid: i32, sig: i32) -> i32 {\n    // SAFETY: kill(pid, 0) is a standard POSIX call that checks PID existence.\n    // No signal is actually sent.\n    unsafe {\n        extern \"C\" {\n            fn kill(pid: i32, sig: i32) -> i32;\n        }\n        kill(pid, sig)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Format a duration in seconds to a human-readable string.\nfn format_duration(secs: u64) -> String {\n    if secs < 60 {\n        format!(\"{secs}s\")\n    } else if secs < 3600 {\n        format!(\"{}m{}s\", secs / 60, secs % 60)\n    } else {\n        format!(\"{}h{}m\", secs / 3600, (secs % 3600) / 60)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Idle-strand cooldown helpers\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Per-row data for the `needle status --idle-strands` cooldown table.\nstruct IdleStrandRow {\n    strand: String,\n    workspace: String,\n    enabled: bool,\n    last_run: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    cooldown_hours: u64,\n    status: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]\nstruct ReflectStateCli {\n    last_consolidation: DateTime<Utc>,\n}\n\n#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]\nstruct LastRunStateCli {\n    last_run: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n}\n\n#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]\nstruct UnravelStateCli {\n    analyzed: std::collections::HashMap<String, DateTime<Utc>>,\n}\n\n/// Compute a short SHA-256 workspace hash (matches strand implementations).\nfn workspace_hash_cli(workspace: &Path) -> String {\n    use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};\n    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();\n    hasher.update(workspace.display().to_string().as_bytes());\n    let result = hasher.finalize();\n    result\n        .iter()\n        .take(8)\n        .fold(String::with_capacity(16), |mut acc, b| {\n            use std::fmt::Write;\n            let _ = write!(acc, \"{b:02x}\");\n            acc\n        })\n}\n\n/// Compute a human-readable cooldown status string for an idle strand.\nfn idle_strand_status(\n    enabled: bool,\n    last_run: Option<DateTime<Utc>>,\n    cooldown_hours: u64,\n    now: DateTime<Utc>,\n) -> String {\n    if !enabled {\n        return \"disabled\".to_string();\n    }\n    match last_run {\n        None => \"ready (never run)\".to_string(),\n        Some(last) => {\n            let elapsed_hours = (now - last).num_hours().max(0) as u64;\n            if elapsed_hours >= cooldown_hours {\n                \"ready\".to_string()\n            } else {\n                let remaining = cooldown_hours - elapsed_hours;\n                format!(\"cooldown ({}h left)\", remaining)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build idle-strand cooldown rows for `needle status --idle-strands`.\n///\n/// Reflect uses a single shared state file (not per-workspace-hash) because it\n/// operates on config.workspace.default regardless of which workspace a worker\n/// was launched against. Weave, pulse, and unravel are keyed per workspace path.\n///\n/// Per-workspace vs per-worker gating:\n/// - reflect: workspace-level gate shared by all workers; cooldown_hours and\n///   min_beads_since_last both count against the same state file\n/// - weave/pulse/unravel: per-workspace state, so a fleet of workers on N\n///   workspaces maintains N independent cooldown windows per strand\nfn idle_strand_rows(\n    config: &Config,\n    state_base: &Path,\n    workspaces: &[PathBuf],\n) -> Vec<IdleStrandRow> {\n    let now = Utc::now();\n    let mut rows = Vec::new();\n\n    // Reflect: single shared state file — show once for config.workspace.default.\n    {\n        let state_path = state_base.join(\"reflect\").join(\"reflect_state.json\");\n        let last_run = std::fs::read_to_string(&state_path)\n            .ok()\n            .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<ReflectStateCli>(&s).ok())\n            .map(|s| s.last_consolidation);\n        let cooldown = config.strands.reflect.cooldown_hours;\n        rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n            strand: \"reflect\".to_string(),\n            workspace: config.workspace.default.display().to_string(),\n            enabled: config.strands.reflect.enabled,\n            last_run,\n            cooldown_hours: cooldown,\n            status: idle_strand_status(config.strands.reflect.enabled, last_run, cooldown, now),\n        });\n    }\n\n    // Weave, pulse, unravel: one row per workspace per strand.\n    for workspace in workspaces {\n        let hash = workspace_hash_cli(workspace);\n        let ws = workspace.display().to_string();\n\n        // Weave\n        {\n            let path = state_base.join(\"weave\").join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"));\n            let last_run = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                .ok()\n                .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<LastRunStateCli>(&s).ok())\n                .and_then(|s| s.last_run);\n            let cooldown = config.strands.weave.cooldown_hours;\n            rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n                strand: \"weave\".to_string(),\n                workspace: ws.clone(),\n                enabled: config.strands.weave.enabled,\n                last_run,\n                cooldown_hours: cooldown,\n                status: idle_strand_status(config.strands.weave.enabled, last_run, cooldown, now),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Pulse\n        {\n            let path = state_base.join(\"pulse\").join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"));\n            let last_run = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                .ok()\n                .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<LastRunStateCli>(&s).ok())\n                .and_then(|s| s.last_run);\n            let cooldown = config.strands.pulse.cooldown_hours;\n            rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n                strand: \"pulse\".to_string(),\n                workspace: ws.clone(),\n                enabled: config.strands.pulse.enabled,\n                last_run,\n                cooldown_hours: cooldown,\n                status: idle_strand_status(config.strands.pulse.enabled, last_run, cooldown, now),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Unravel: per-bead cooldown — most recent analysis time as proxy for last run.\n        {\n            let path = state_base.join(\"unravel\").join(format!(\"{hash}.json\"));\n            let last_run = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                .ok()\n                .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str::<UnravelStateCli>(&s).ok())\n                .and_then(|s| s.analyzed.values().copied().max());\n            let cooldown = config.strands.unravel.cooldown_hours;\n            rows.push(IdleStrandRow {\n                strand: \"unravel\".to_string(),\n                workspace: ws.clone(),\n                enabled: config.strands.unravel.enabled,\n                last_run,\n                cooldown_hours: cooldown,\n                status: idle_strand_status(config.strands.unravel.enabled, last_run, cooldown, now),\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    rows\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// tmux session discovery\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A running tmux session belonging to needle.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]\nstruct TmuxSession {\n    name: String,\n    created: String,\n    status: String,\n    /// PID of the needle run process in this session (if available).\n    pid: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n/// List all tmux sessions whose names start with `needle-`.\nfn list_needle_sessions() -> Result<Vec<TmuxSession>> {\n    let output = ProcessCommand::new(\"tmux\")\n        .args([\n            \"list-sessions\",\n            \"-F\",\n            \"#{session_name}\\t#{session_created}\\t#{session_attached}\\t#{pane_pid}\",\n        ])\n        .output();\n\n    let output = match output {\n        Ok(o) => o,\n        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {\n            // tmux not installed — no sessions.\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            return Err(e).context(\"failed to run tmux list-sessions\");\n        }\n    };\n\n    // tmux exits non-zero when there are no sessions.\n    if !output.status.success() {\n        return Ok(vec![]);\n    }\n\n    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);\n    let sessions = stdout\n        .lines()\n        .filter_map(|line| {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('\\t').collect();\n            if parts.len() < 4 {\n                return None;\n            }\n            let name = parts[0];\n            if !name.starts_with(\"needle-\") {\n                return None;\n            }\n            let created = parts[1].to_string();\n            let attached = parts[2];\n            let status = if attached == \"1\" {\n                \"attached\".to_string()\n            } else {\n                \"detached\".to_string()\n            };\n            // Parse PID from pane_pid (tmux returns empty string if no pane)\n            let pid = parts[3].parse::<u32>().ok();\n            Some(TmuxSession {\n                name: name.to_string(),\n                created,\n                status,\n                pid,\n            })\n        })\n        .collect();\n\n    Ok(sessions)\n}\n\n/// Return the set of worker IDs already running for a given agent.\n///\n/// Parses tmux session names matching `needle-{agent}-{worker_id}` and returns\n/// the `{worker_id}` portion. Returns an empty set if no sessions are running\n/// or tmux is unavailable.\nfn occupied_worker_ids(agent: &str) -> Result<HashSet<String>> {\n    let prefix = sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent}-\"));\n    let sessions = list_needle_sessions()?;\n    let ids = sessions\n        .iter()\n        .filter_map(|s| s.name.strip_prefix(&prefix))\n        .map(|id| id.to_string())\n        .collect();\n    Ok(ids)\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Process table discovery\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A needle process discovered from the process table.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct DiscoveredProcess {\n    pid: u32,\n    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n    agent: Option<String>,\n    identifier: Option<String>,\n    /// Full command line for debugging\n    cmdline: String,\n}\n\n/// Scan the process table for all running `needle run` processes.\n///\n/// This discovers workers regardless of how they were started (tmux-wrapped or\n/// bare NEEDLE_INNER=1 invocation). It reads /proc to find processes whose\n/// command line contains \"needle run\" and extracts workspace, agent, and\n/// identifier from the arguments.\n#[cfg(unix)]\nfn scan_needle_processes() -> Result<Vec<DiscoveredProcess>> {\n    use std::fs;\n\n    let mut discovered = Vec::new();\n\n    // Iterate over all entries in /proc.\n    let proc_dir = Path::new(\"/proc\");\n    let entries = match fs::read_dir(proc_dir) {\n        Ok(e) => e,\n        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {\n            // Not Linux — no process table available.\n            return Ok(vec![]);\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            return Err(e).context(\"failed to read /proc directory\");\n        }\n    };\n\n    for entry in entries {\n        let entry = match entry {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let pid_str = entry.file_name();\n        let pid: u32 = match pid_str.to_string_lossy().parse() {\n            Ok(p) => p,\n            Err(_) => continue, // Not a numeric directory (not a PID)\n        };\n\n        // Read the process's command line.\n        let cmdline_path = entry.path().join(\"cmdline\");\n        let cmdline_bytes = match fs::read(&cmdline_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(_) => continue, // Process may have exited\n        };\n\n        // cmdline is null-separated; convert to space-separated for parsing.\n        let cmdline: String = cmdline_bytes\n            .split(|&b| b == 0)\n            .map(|args| String::from_utf8_lossy(args))\n            .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n            .join(\" \");\n\n        // Check if this is a needle run process.\n        // The command line looks like: \"/path/to/needle run --workspace /path --count 1 ...\"\n        // Also handle NEEDLE_INNER=1 invocations: \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 /path/to/needle run ...\"\n        // Also handle cases where the binary is called via symlink or absolute path.\n        //\n        // IMPORTANT: Exclude shell wrapper processes (bash -c \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 needle run ...\")\n        // We only want to discover the actual needle worker process, not the shell wrapper.\n        // The shell wrapper has a cmdline like: \"bash -c NEEDLE_INNER=1 /path/to/needle run ...\"\n        if !cmdline.contains(\"needle run\")\n            && !cmdline.contains(\"needle-worker\")\n            && !cmdline.contains(\"NEEDLE_INNER\")\n        {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Filter out shell wrapper processes (bash -c \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 needle run ...\").\n        // These are created by tmux sessions and are not the actual needle worker processes.\n        // We only want to discover processes that are directly executing needle, not shell wrappers.\n        if cmdline.starts_with(\"bash -c\")\n            || cmdline.starts_with(\"sh -c\")\n            || cmdline.starts_with(\"/bin/bash -c\")\n            || cmdline.starts_with(\"/bin/sh -c\")\n        {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Parse arguments to extract workspace, agent, identifier.\n        // Handle NEEDLE_INNER=1 prefix in cmdline: \"NEEDLE_INNER=1 /path/to/needle run ...\"\n        let args: Vec<&str> = cmdline.split_whitespace().collect();\n        let mut workspace = None;\n        let mut agent = None;\n        let mut identifier = None;\n\n        let mut i = 0;\n        while i < args.len() {\n            match args[i] {\n                // Skip NEEDLE_INNER environment variable prefix\n                \"NEEDLE_INNER=1\" => {\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n                \"--workspace\" | \"-w\" => {\n                    if i + 1 < args.len() {\n                        workspace = Some(PathBuf::from(args[i + 1]));\n                        i += 2;\n                    } else {\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n                \"--agent\" | \"-a\" => {\n                    if i + 1 < args.len() {\n                        agent = Some(args[i + 1].to_string());\n                        i += 2;\n                    } else {\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n                \"--identifier\" | \"-i\" if i + 1 < args.len() => {\n                    identifier = Some(args[i + 1].to_string());\n                    i += 2;\n                }\n                \"--identifier\" | \"-i\" => {\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        discovered.push(DiscoveredProcess {\n            pid,\n            workspace,\n            agent,\n            identifier,\n            cmdline,\n        });\n    }\n\n    Ok(discovered)\n}\n\n/// Stub for non-Unix platforms (Windows, etc.).\n#[cfg(not(unix))]\nfn scan_needle_processes() -> Result<Vec<DiscoveredProcess>> {\n    // No /proc on these platforms.\n    Ok(vec![])\n}\n\n/// Reconcile discovered processes against the registry and emit warnings.\n///\n/// This function compares processes found in the process table against the\n/// worker registry and emits warnings for any unregistered needle run processes.\n/// It helps identify workers that failed to register during boot due to disk\n/// errors, permission issues, or other failures.\n#[cfg(unix)]\nfn reconcile_process_registry(discovered: &[DiscoveredProcess], registry: &Registry) -> Result<()> {\n    use std::collections::HashSet;\n\n    let workers = registry.list().unwrap_or_default();\n    let registered_pids: HashSet<u32> = workers.iter().map(|w| w.pid).collect();\n\n    // Find processes not in the registry\n    let unregistered: Vec<&DiscoveredProcess> = discovered\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|p| !registered_pids.contains(&p.pid))\n        .collect();\n\n    if !unregistered.is_empty() {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"⚠️  WARNING: Found {} unregistered needle run process(es):\",\n            unregistered.len()\n        );\n        for proc in &unregistered {\n            let workspace = proc\n                .workspace\n                .as_ref()\n                .map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| \"<unknown>\".to_string());\n            let agent = proc.agent.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"<unknown>\");\n            let identifier = proc.identifier.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"<unknown>\");\n            eprintln!(\n                \"  PID {} — workspace: {}, agent: {}, identifier: {}\",\n                proc.pid, workspace, agent, identifier\n            );\n        }\n        eprintln!(\"These workers may have failed to register during boot due to:\");\n        eprintln!(\"  - Disk full or permission errors on ~/.needle/state/workers.json\");\n        eprintln!(\"  - Registry file corruption or concurrent write conflicts\");\n        eprintln!(\"  - Early termination during worker boot before registry registration\");\n        eprintln!(\"The workers will continue processing beads but are invisible to 'needle status' and 'needle list'.\");\n        eprintln!(\"To fix:\");\n        eprintln!(\"  1. Check disk space: df -h ~/.needle\");\n        eprintln!(\"  2. Check permissions: ls -la ~/.needle/state/\");\n        eprintln!(\"  3. Kill and restart affected workers to force re-registration\");\n        eprintln!();\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Stub for non-Unix platforms (Windows, etc.).\n#[cfg(not(unix))]\nfn ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `needle canary` — run canary tests or show channel status.\nfn cmd_canary(show_status: bool) -> Result<()> {\n      config.self_modification.canary_timeout,\n    );\n\n    if show_status {\n        let status = runner.status()?;\n        println!(\"Release Channel Status\");\n pick_available_names(occupied: &HashSet<String>, count: usize) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut ids = Vec::with_capacity(count);\n        for name in NATO_ALPHABET {\n            if ids.len() >= count {\n                break;\n            }\n            if occupied.contains(*name) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            ids.push(name.to_string());\n        }\n        if ids.len() < count {\n            bail!(\n                \"cannot launch {} workers — only {} NATO names available ({} occupied)\",\n                count,\n                ids.len(),\n                occupied.len()\n            );\n        }\n        Ok(ids)\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_no_sessions_running() {\n        let occupied = HashSet::new();\n        let names = pick_available_names(&occupied, 3).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(names, vec![\"alpha\", \"bravo\", \"charlie\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_skips_occupied() {\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = [\"alpha\", \"bravo\"].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();\n        let names = pick_available_names(&occupied, 2).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(names, vec![\"charlie\", \"delta\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_skips_non_contiguous_occupied() {\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = [\"alpha\", \"charlie\", \"echo\"]\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| s.to_string())\n            .collect();\n        let names = pick_available_names(&occupied, 3).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(names, vec![\"bravo\", \"delta\", \"foxtrot\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_all_occupied_fails() {\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = NATO_ALPHABET.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();\n        let result = pick_available_names(&occupied, 1);\n        assert!(result.is_err());\n        let msg = result.unwrap_err().to_string();\n        assert!(msg.contains(\"26 occupied\"), \"got: {msg}\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn pick_names_partial_exhaustion_fails() {\n        // Occupy 25 names, request 2 — only 1 available.\n        let occupied: HashSet<String> = NATO_ALPHABET[..25].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();\n        let result = pick_available_names(&occupied, 2);\n        assert!(result.is_err());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn identifier_collision_detected() {\n        let HashMap::new();\n        ppid_to_children.insert(1, vec![2, 3]);\n        ppid_to_children.insert(2, vec![4]);\n        ppid_to_children.insert(3, vec![5, 6]);\n\n        let mut descendants = Vec::new();\n        let mut visited = HashSet::new();\n\n        // Mark the root PID as visited to prevent cycles (same as production code)\n        visited.insert(1);\n\n        find_descendants_recursive(1, &ppid_to_children, &mut descendants, &mut visited);\n\n        // Should find all descendants: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\n        assert_eq!(descendants.len(), 5);\n        assert!(descendants.contains(&2));\n        assert!(descendants.contains(&3));\n        assert!(descendants.contains(&4));\n        assert!(descendants.contains(&5));\n        assert!(descendants.contains(&6));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn find_all_descendants_handles_cycles() {\n        // Test that the visited set prevents infinite loops\n        use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};\n\n        // Create a cycle: 1 -> [2], 2 -> [1]\n        let mut ppid_to_children: HashMap<u32, Vec<u32>> = HashMap::new();\n        ppid_to_children.insert(1, vec![2]);\n        ppid_to_children.insert(2, vec![1]);\n\n        let mut descendants = Vec::new();\n        let mut visited = HashSet::new();\n\n        // Mark the root PID as visited to prevent cycles (same as production code)\n        visited.insert(1);\n\n        // This should not loop infinitely\n        find_descendants_recursive(1, &ppid_to_children, &mut descendants, &mut visited);\n\n        // Should find 2, then stop when it encounters 1 again (already visited)\n        assert_eq!(descendants.len(), 1);\n        assert!(descendants.contains(&2));\n    }\n\n JSON value.\n    pub fn to_data(&self) -> serde_json::Value {\n        match self {\n            EventKind::WorkerBooting {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStarted {\n                worker_name,\n                version,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_name, \"version\": version })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerStopped {\n                reason,\n                beads_processed,\n                uptime_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"reason\": reason,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                    \"uptime_secs\": uptime_secs,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerErrored {\n                error_type,\n                error_message,\n                beads_processed,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"error_type\": error_type,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"beads_processed\": beads_processed,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerExhausted {\n                cycle_count,\n                last_strand,\n                waterfall_restarts,\n                restart_triggers,\n                strand_evaluations,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"cycle_count\": cycle_count,\n                    \"last_strand_evaluated\": last_strand,\n                    \"waterfall_restarts\": waterfall_restarts,\n                    \"restart_triggers\": restart_triggers,\n                    \"strand_evaluations\": strand_evaluations,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerIdle { backoff_seconds } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"backoff_seconds\": backoff_seconds })\n            }\n            EventKind::StateTransition { from, to } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"from\": format!(\"{from}\"), \"to\": format!(\"{to}\") })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepStarted { step } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step })\n            }\n            EventKind::InitStepCompleted { step, duration_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"step\": step, \"duration_ms\": duration_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerBootTimeout { elapsed_ms } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"elapsed_ms\": elapsed_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerLaunchDeferred {\n                deferred_count,\n                total_wait_secs,\n                reason,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"deferred_count\": deferred_count,\n                    \"total_wait_secs\": total_wait_secs,\n                    \"reason\": reason\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StrandEvaluated {\n                strand_name,\n                result,\n                duration_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"strand_name\": strand_name,\n                    \"result\": result,\n                    \"duration_ms\": duration_ms,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StrandSkipped {\n                strand_name,\n                reason,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"strand_name\": strand_name, \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadStoreError {\n                strand_name,\n                operation,\n                error_message,\n                stderr,\n                exit_code,\n                workspace,\n            } => {\n                let mut data = serde_json::json!({\n                    \"strand_name\": strand_name,\n                    \"operation\": operation,\n                    \"error_message\": error_message,\n                    \"stderr\": stderr,\n                    \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n                });\n                if let Some(ws) = workspace {\n                    if let Some(obj) = data.as_object_mut() {\n                        obj.insert(\"workspace\".to_string(), serde_json::json!(ws));\n                    }\n                }\n                data\n            }\n            EventKind::QueueEmpty => serde_json::json!({}),\n            EventKind::PluckStarvationDetected {\n                workspace,\n                open_count,\n                excluded_count,\n                candidate_exclusion_reasons,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"workspace\": workspace,\n                    \"open_count\": open_count,\n                    \"excluded_count\": excluded_count,\n                    \"candidate_exclusion_reasons\": candidate_exclusion_reasons,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimAttempt { bead_id, attempt } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"attempt\": attempt })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimSuccess {\n                bead_id,\n                priority,\n                strand,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"priority\": priority,\n                    \"strand\": strand,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimRaceLost { bead_id } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref() })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimRaceLostSkipped {\n                consecutive_losses,\n                threshold,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"consecutive_losses\": consecutive_losses,\n                    \"threshold\": threshold,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::ClaimFailed { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadReleased { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadReleaseFailed { bead_id, reason } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"reason\": reason })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadCompleted {\n                bead_id,\n                duration_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"duration_ms\": duration_ms })\n            }\n            EventKind::BeadOrphaned { bead_id } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref() })\n            }\n            EventKind::DispatchStarted {\n                bead_id,\n                agent,\n                prompt_len,\n                template_name,\n                template_version,\n                prompt_hash,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"agent\": agent,\n                    \"prompt_len\": prompt_len,\n                    \"template_name\": template_name,\n                    \"template_version\": template_version,\n                    \"prompt_hash\": format!(\"sha256:{prompt_hash}\"),\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::DispatchCompleted {\n                bead_id,\n                exit_code,\n                duration_ms,\n                agent,\n                model,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n                    \"duration_ms\": duration_ms,\n                    \"agent\": agent,\n                    \"model\": model,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::RoutingDecision {\n                bead_id,\n                model,\n                matched_rule,\n                chosen_adapter,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"model\": model,\n                    \"matched_rule\": matched_rule,\n                    \"chosen_adapter\": chosen_adapter,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::RoutingFailed {\n                bead_id,\n                model,\n                rules_tried,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"model\": model,\n                    \"rules_tried\": rules_tried,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::BuildTimeout {\n                bead_id,\n                timeout_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"timeout_secs\": timeout_secs,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::BuildHeartbeat {\n                bead_id,\n                elapsed_ms,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"elapsed_ms\": elapsed_ms,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::OutcomeClassified {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                exit_code,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"outcome\": outcome,\n                    \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::OutcomeHandled {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                action,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"outcome\": outcome,\n                    \"action\": action,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::WorkerHandlingTimeout {\n                bead_id,\n                outcome,\n                operation,\n                error,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"outcome\": outcome,\n                    \"operation\": operation,\n                    \"error\": error,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::HeartbeatEmitted { bead_id, state } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref().map(|b| b.as_ref()),\n                    \"state\": state,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::StuckDetected { bead_id, age_secs } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"age_secs\": age_secs })\n            }\n            EventKind::StuckReleased {\n                bead_id,\n                peer_worker,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(), \"peer_worker\": peer_worker })\n            }\n            EventKind::HealthCheck {\n                db_healthy,\n                disk_free_mb,\n                peer_count,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"db_healthy\": db_healthy,\n                    \"disk_free_mb\": disk_free_mb,\n                    \"peer_count\": peer_count,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::FleetCpuSaturated {\n                load_average,\n                threshold,\n                core_count,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"load_average\": load_average,\n                    \"threshold\": threshold,\n                    \"core_count\": core_count,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::FleetMemoryLow {\n                free_mb,\n                threshold_mb,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"free_mb\": free_mb,\n                    \"threshold_mb\": threshold_mb,\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendOrphanedLockRemoved {\n                lock_path,\n                age_secs,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"lock_path\": lock_path, \"age_secs\": age_secs })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendDependencyCleaned {\n                bead_id,\n                blocker_id,\n            } => {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"bead_id\": bead_id.as_ref(),\n                    \"blocker_id\": blocker_id.as_ref(),\n                })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendDbRepaired { warnings, fixed } => {\n                serde_json::json!({ \"warnings\": warnings, \"fixed\": fixed })\n            }\n            EventKind::MendDbRebuilt => serde_json::json!({}),\n            EventKind::MendCycleSummary {\n                beads_released,\n                locks_removed,\n                deps_cleaned,\n      | EventKind::MendStaleAssigneeCleared { .. }\n            | EventKind::MendAssigneeClearFailed { .. } => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Sink trait ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Pluggable output backend for telemetry events.\n///\n/// Implement this trait to add a new sink — register an instance in the\n/// `TelemetryBus` and events fan out automatically, with no special-casing.\npub trait Sink: Send + Sync {\n    /// Accept a single event.   }\n\n    /// Construct a sink writing to a specific directory.\n    ///\n    /// Creates the directory (and parents) if it does not exist.\n    pub fn with_dir(log_dir: &Path, worker_id: &str,    version,\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), // 5 second timeout\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Write a boot event directly to the file with a timeout.\n    ///\n    /// This is a &std::sync::Mutex<std::io::BufWriter<std::fs::File>>,\n        path: &Path,\n        worker_id: &str,\n        session_id: &str,\n        version: &str,\n        timeout: std::time::Duration,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        use std::sync::mpsc;\n        use std::thread;\n\n        let event = TelemetryEvent {\n            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n       workspace: None,\n            duration_ms: None,\n            data: serde_json::json!({ \"worker_name\": worker_id, \"version\": version }),\n            trace_id: None,\n            span_id: None,\n        };\n        let line = serde_json::to_string(&event)?;\n        let path_for_error = path.display().to_string();\n        let path_clone = path.to_path_buf();\n\n        // JoinHandle::join() has no timeout in Rust's std — use a channel with recv_timeout.\n        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<Result<(), String>>();\n\n        // The JoinHandle is intentionally dropped on timeout: dropping detaches the thread,\n        // which continues running until it completes or the process exits.\n        let _handle = thread::spawn(move || {\n            let result: Result<(), String> = (|| {\n                let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                    .create(true)\n                    .append(true)\n                    .open(&path_clone)\n                    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                let mut writer = std::io::BufWriter::new(file);\n                writeln!(writer, \"{line}\").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                writer.flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                writer.get_ref().sync_all().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n                Ok(())\n            })();\n            // Ignore send error: receiver may have timed out and been dropped.\n            let _ = tx.send(result);\n        });\n\n        match rx.recv_timeout(timeout) {\n            Ok(Ok(())) => Ok(()),\n            Ok(Err(e)) => Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"failed to write boot event to {}: {}\",\n                path_for_error,\n                e\n            )),\n            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Timeout) => Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"timed out writing boot event to {} after {:?} (filesystem may be hung)\",\n                path_for_error,\n                timeout\n            )),\n            Err(mpsc::RecvTimeoutError::Disconnected) => Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"boot event writer thread disconnected for {}\",\n                path_for_error\n            )),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Sink for FileSink {\n    fn accept(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        let line = serde_json::to_string(event)?;\n        let mut writer = self\n            .writer\n            .lock()\n            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"lock poisoned: {}\", e))?;\n        writeln!(writer, \"{line}\")?;\n        writer.flush()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn flush(&self, _deadline: std::time::Duration) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        let mut writer = self\n            .writer\n            .lock()\n            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"lock poisoned: {}\", e))?;\n        writer.flush()?;\n        // fsync to ensure durability before shutdown\n        writer.get_ref().sync_all()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── StdoutSink ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Human-readable, color-coded telemetry sink for   }\n}\n\n/// Check if stdout is a terminal (for auto color detection).\nfn atty_stdout() -> bool {\n    unsafe { libc_isatty(1) != 0 }\n}\n\nextern \"C\" {\n    #[link_name = \"isatty\"]\n    fn libc_isatty(fd: i32) -> i32;\n}\n\n/// Public wrapper for formatting milliseconds as human-readable duration.\npub fn format_duration_ms_public(ms: u64) -> String {\n    format_duration_ms(ms)\n}\n\n/// Format milliseconds as human-readable duration.\nfn format_duration_ms(ms: u64) -> String {\n    if ms < 1000 {\n        format!(\"{ms}ms\")\n    } else if ms < 60_000 {\n        format!(\"{:.1}s\", ms as f64 / 1000.0)\n    } else {\n        let mins = ms / 60_000;\n        let secs = (ms % 60_000) / 1000;\n        format!(\"{mins}m{secs}s\")\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Session ID generation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Generate an 8-hex-char session ID.\n///\n/// Uses `/dev/urandom` when available, falls back to PID XOR timestamp.\npub fn generate_session_id() -> String {\n    // Try /dev/urandom (Linux/macOS)\n    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::File::open(\"/dev/urandom\") {\n        use std::io::Read;\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 4];\n        if f.read_exact(&mut buf).is_ok() {\n            return format!(\"{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}{:02x}\", buf[0], buf[1], buf[2], buf[3]);\n        }\n    }\n    // Fallback: PID XOR nanosecond timestamp\n    let pid = std::process::id();\n    let ts = Utc::now().timestamp_millis() as u64;\n    let hash = pid as u64 ^ ts;\n    format!(\"{:08x}\", hash & 0xffff_ffff)\n}\n\n// ─── Trace context helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Returns `(trace_id_hex, span_id_hex)` from the current OTel span context,\n/// or `(None, None)` when not inside a valid span.\n#[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\nfn current_trace_ids() -> (Option<String>, Option<String>) {\n    use opentelemetry::trace::TraceContextExt;\n    let ctx = opentelemetry::Context::current();\n    let binding = ctx.span();\n    let span_ctx = binding.span_context();\n    if span_ctx.is_valid() {\n        (\n            Some(hex::encode(span_ctx.trace_id().to_bytes())),\n            Some(hex::encode(span_ctx.span_id().to_bytes())),\n        )\n    } else {\n        (None, None)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(not(feature = \"otlp\"))]\nfn current_trace_ids() -> (Option<String>, Option<String>) {\n    (None, None)\n}\n\n// ─── HookSink ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A compiled hook: a pre-compiled regex filter + dispatch target(s).\nstruct CompiledHook {\n    filter: regex::Regex,\n    /// Shell command (empty = disabled).\n    command: String,\n    /// Webhook URL (None = disabled).\n    url: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Dispatches matching telemetry events to external commands and/or URLs.\n///\n/// Each hook has a glob pattern matched against `event_type`. When an event\n/// matches, the event JSON is piped to `command`'s stdin and/or HTTP-POSTed\n/// to `url`. Execution is fire-and-forget — failed hooks emit `SinkError`\n/// events to the file sink but never block the worker or recurse into hooks.\npub struct HookSink {\n    hooks: Vec<CompiledHook>,\n}\n\nimpl HookSink {\n    /// Compile hook configs into a `HookSink`.\n    ///\n    /// Returns an error if any `event_filter` is an invalid glob pattern.\n    pub fn new(configs: &[crate::config::HookConfig]) -> Result<Self> {\n        let mut hooks = Vec::with_capacity(configs.len());\n        for cfg in configs {\n            let filter = glob_to_regex(&cfg.event_filter)\n                .with_context(|| format!(\"invalid hook filter: {}\", cfg.event_filter))?;\n            hooks.push(CompiledHook {\n                filter,\n                command: cfg.command.clone(),\n                url: cfg.url.clone(),\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(HookSink { hooks })\n    }\n\n    /// Check whether any hooks are configured.\n    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.hooks.is_empty()\n    }\n\n    /// Dispatch an event to all matching hooks (fire-and-forget).\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of `SinkError` events for hooks that failed, so the\n    /// caller can write them to the file sink without recursion.\n    pub fn dispatch(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Vec<TelemetryEvent> {\n        // Never dispatch SinkError events to hooks — prevents recursion.\n        if event.event_type == \"telemetry.sink_error\" {\n            return Vec::new();\n        }\n\n        let json = match serde_json::to_string(event) {\n            Ok(j) => j,\n            Err(_) => return Vec::new(),\n        };\n\n        let mut failures = Vec::new();\n        for hook in &self.hooks {\n            if !hook.filter.is_match(&event.event_type) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Dispatch to command if configured.\n            if !hook.command.is_empty() {\n                match Self::run_hook(&hook.command, &json) {\n                    Ok(()) => {}\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        failures.push(TelemetryEvent {\n                            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n                            event_type: \"telemetry.sink_error\".to_string(),\n                            worker_id: event.worker_id.clone(),\n                            session_id: event.session_id.clone(),\n                            sequence: 0, // sequence is set by the emitter, not here\n                            bead_id: None,\n                            workspace: None,\n                            data: serde_json::json!({\n                                \"hook_command\": hook.command,\n                                \"event_filter\": hook.filter.as_str(),\n                                \"original_event_type\": event.event_type,\n                                \"error\": e.to_string(),\n                            }),\n                            duration_ms: None,\n                            trace_id: None,\n                            span_id: None,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Dispatch to URL if configured.\n            if let Some(ref url) = hook.url {\n                match Self::post_url(url, &json) {\n                    Ok(()) => {}\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        failures.push(TelemetryEvent {\n                            timestamp: Utc::now(),\n                            event_type: \"telemetry.sink_error\".to_string(),\n                            worker_id: event.worker_id.clone(),\n                            session_id: event.session_id.clone(),\n                            sequence: 0,\n                            bead_id: None,\n                            workspace: None,\n                            data: serde_json::json!({\n                                \"hook_url\": url,\n                                \"event_filter\": hook.filter.as_str(),\n                                \"original_event_type\": event.event_type,\n                                \"error\": e.to_string(),\n                            }),\n                            duration_ms: None,\n                            trace_id: None,\n                            span_id: None,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        failures\n    }\n\n    /// Execute a single hook command, piping JSON to its stdin.\n    ///\n    /// Spawns `sh -c <command>` with the event JSON on stdin, waits for\n    /// completion, and returns an error if the command exits non-zero.\n    /// This runs inside the background writer task so blocking is acceptable.\n    fn run_hook(command: &str, json: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        use std::process::{Command, Stdio};\n\n        let mut child = Command::new(\"sh\")\n            .arg(\"-c\")\n            .arg(command)\n            .stdin(Stdio::piped())\n            .stdout(Stdio::null())\n            .stderr(Stdio::null())\n            .spawn()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to spawn hook: {command}\"))?;\n\n        if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {\n            // Best-effort write; ignore broken pipe if child exits early.\n            let _ = stdin.write_all(json.as_bytes());\n        }\n\n        // Wait for the child and check exit status.\n        let status = child\n            .wait()\n            .with_context(|| format!(\"failed to wait for hook: {command}\"))?;\n\n        if !status.success() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\n                \"hook exited with status {}: {command}\",\n                status.code().unwrap_or(-1)\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// HTTP POST the event JSON to a webhook URL.\n    ///\n    /// Sets `Content-Type: application/json` and applies a 10-second timeout.\n    /// Returns an error if the request fails or the server returns a non-2xx\n    /// status. This runs inside the background writer task so blocking is\n    /// acceptable.\n    fn post_url(url: &str, json: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        ureq::post(url)\n            .set(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n            .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10))\n            .send_string(json)\n            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(\"webhook POST to {url} failed: {e}\"))?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Sink for HookSink {\n    fn accept(&self, event: &TelemetryEvent) -> Result<()> {\n        let failures = self.dispatch(event);\n        for fail in &failures {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                hook_error = %fail.data,\n                original_event = %event.event_type,\n                \"telemetry hook dispatch failed\"\n            );\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn flush(&self, _deadline: std::time::Duration) -> Result<()> {\n        // hooks run synchronously in accept(); nothing to drain\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ─── Telemetry emitter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Non-blocking telemetry emitter.\n///\n/// Cloning a `Telemetry` handle is cheap — it shares the same background\n/// writer and sequence counter.\n///\n/// The writer task must be started by calling `start()` from within a tokio\n/// runtime context. This is typically done at the beginning of `Worker::run()`.\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct Telemetry {\n    worker_id: WorkerId,\n    session_id: String,\n    sequence: Arc<AtomicU64>,\n    /// Wrapped tokio::task::JoinHandle) because the\n    /// writer runs in its own dedicated thread with its own tokio runtime,\n    /// ensuring it can process messages before the main runtime's block_on().\n    writer_handle: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>>>,\n    /// OTLP sink shutdown handle (feature-gated).\n    /// Stored separately so we can call its async shutdown method.\n    otlp_shutdown: Arc<std::sync::Mutex<Option<OtlpShutdown>>>,\n}\n\n/// Internal message type for the writer task.\n#[allow(clippy::large_enum_variant)]\nenum WriterMessage {\n    Event(TelemetryEvent),\n    Flush(tokio::sync::oneshot::Sender<()>),\n}\n\n/// Holds the receiver and sinks until they can be spawned in an async context.\nstruct PendingWriter {\n    receiver: mpsc::UnboundedReceiver<WriterMessage>,\n    sinks: Vec<Box<dyn Sink>>,\n}\n\n/// Holds an OTLP sink for async shutdown (feature-gated).\nenum OtlpShutdown {\n    #[cfg(feature = \"otlp\")]\n
